newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 2-yr note seen yielding 5.99/6.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 2-yr note seen yielding 5.99/6.00 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $17.5 billion in two-year notes on Wednesday is expected to produce a yield between 5.99 and 6.00 percent, dealers said.
Sentiment going into the auction was positive due to the $750 million cut in the size of the auction, but results weren't expected to be very strong.
At 1234 EST/1734 GMT, the two-year notes were quoted at 6.00 percent in when-issued trade.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EST/1800 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
